vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-49473 - @cedar-policy/authorization-for-expressjs has an authorization bypass via query string manipulation
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-49473
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 11:22 p.m. | 8 minutes ago
  
Description :@cedar-policy/authorization-for-expressjs is an open-source Express.js middleware that integrates Cedar authorization into Express applications by mapping HTTP requests to Cedar actions and evaluating authorization policies before allowing requests to proceed. Versions prior to 0.3.0 have an issue where, under certain circumstances, the middleware matches incoming requests against Cedar action mappings using req.originalUrl, which includes the query string, while Express routes requests using only the path component. The middleware uses req.originalUrl to match incoming requests against Cedar action mappings. In Express, req.originalUrl includes the query string, while route matching uses only the path. This creates a divergence between what Cedar authorizes and what Express executes. When an application defines separate actions for overlapping path prefixes with different authorization requirements (for example, GET /users for listing all users with admin-only access, and GET /users/{id} for retrieving a single user with any authenticated user access), an actor can append a query string to bypass the more restrictive policy. Sending GET /users/?x=1 causes the middleware to match against /users/{id} (with id parameter set to ?x=1) and evaluate the less restrictive action, while Express routes the request to the /users list handler. This allows inappropriate access to the more restrictive endpoint. This issue has been addressed in version 0.30. Some workarounds are available. Validate and sanitize incoming request paths before they reach the authorization middleware. Ensure that applications do not rely solely on the middleware for authorization when defining multiple actions on overlapping path prefixes with different permission levels.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-73493 - http4s-blaze-server: Unbounded WebSocket message aggregation
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-73493
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 10:17 p.m. | 47 minutes ago
  
Description :Http4s (http4s-blaze-server) is a minimal, idiomatic Scala interface for HTTP services. Prior to 0.23.18 and 1.0.0-M42, http4s-blaze-server aggregates fragments of an incoming WebSocket message with no limit on total size or fragment count. A client that completes a WebSocket handshake can send an unterminated fragmented message and drive unbounded heap growth in the server JVM, resulting in denial of service through OutOfMemoryError. Any http4s application serving WebSocket routes over BlazeServerBuilder is affected, no non-default configuration is required, and maxWebSocketBufferSize does not bound the aggregate because it bounds only individual frames. A single connection sending continuation frames that never set FIN forces the server to buffer every fragment until the heap is exhausted, terminating the JVM with OutOfMemoryError on the blaze selector thread. Small fragments amplify the cost through per-frame object overhead, so a modest volume of wire bytes is sufficient. This issue is fixed in versions 0.23.18 and 1.0.0-M42.
  
Severity: 7.5 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-13622 - Kubevirt: virt-handler-rhel9: kubevirt: virt-handler migration proxy follows symlinks allowing container escape to host
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-13622
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 8:46 p.m. | 18 minutes ago
  
Description :A symlink following vulnerability was found in KubeVirt's virt-handler migration proxy. During live migration, virt-handler dials Unix sockets inside the target virt-launcher pod via /proc//root/ paths using net.Dial() without symlink protection. These socket paths reside in qemu-owned directories writable by the virt-launcher user. An attacker with namespace edit and pods/exec permissions can replace a migration proxy socket with a symlink to the host CRI-O socket. Because virt-handler runs as root in the host mount namespace, absolute symlink targets resolve against the host filesystem, and the bidirectional io.Copy proxy relays attacker-controlled bytes to the container runtime, enabling full node compromise.
  
Severity: 8.8 | HIGH

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-73431 - Reusable Account Activation and Recovery Tokens Allow Repeated Account Takeover in vulnerability-lookup
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-73431
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 2:32 p.m. | 30 minutes ago
  
Description :Vulnerability-Lookup contains an 
authentication weakness in its account activation and password-recovery 
mechanism. Activation and recovery links were generated using stateless 
signed tokens containing only the user's login. Although the token 
signature and age were validated, the application did not track whether a
 token had already been successfully used. As a result, a captured 
activation or password-recovery link remained valid for the entire 
configured TOKEN_VALIDITY_PERIOD, even after the associated password had been changed. 


An attacker who obtains a valid 
activation or recovery token could therefore replay it multiple times 
during its validity period to set a new password and repeatedly take 
control of the affected account. In addition, tokens were not bound to a
 specific purpose, allowing the same token mechanism to be used across 
activation and recovery workflows. The patch introduces purpose-bound 
tokens and a random nonce whose SHA-256 digest is stored with the user 
account. The nonce is invalidated after a successful password change, 
making tokens single-use, while issuing a new token invalidates any 
previously issued token.  The password-setting operation now explicitly consumes the token before committing the account change. 


Successful exploitation requires 
the attacker to obtain a currently valid activation or recovery link, 
but does not require knowledge of the victim's existing password or an 
authenticated session.
  
Severity: 8.8 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-73405 - Authorization Bypass in SSE Pub/Sub Allows Unconfirmed Accounts to Access Stream Events in vulnerability-lookup
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-73405
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 2:15 p.m. | 47 minutes ago
  
Description :An authorization bypass vulnerability in Vulnerability-Lookup allowed inactive or unconfirmed accounts to subscribe to Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams through the /pubsub/subscribe/ endpoint.


The token_required decorator used by the Pub/Sub interface authenticated requests solely by matching the X-API-KEY header against an existing user API key. Unlike the REST API authentication mechanism, it did not verify the account's is_active and is_confirmed state.


Because the self-registration process issues an API key before account confirmation is completed, an attacker could create an account and immediately use the resulting API key to access Pub/Sub topics that should only be available to active, confirmed users. This could expose stream events that would otherwise be inaccessible through the REST API, including newly submitted or not-yet-moderated data such as comments.


The vulnerability results from inconsistent authorization enforcement between the REST API and the SSE streaming interface.


The patch corrects the issue by requiring accounts to be both active and confirmed before permitting access to Pub/Sub streams, bringing the SSE authorization boundary in line with the REST API.
  
Severity: 5.3 | MEDIUM
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

Pub/Sub 인터페이스에서 사용하는 token_required 데코레이터는 X-API-KEY 헤더를 기존 사용자 API 키와 일치시키는 방식으로만 요청을 인증했습니다. REST API 인증 메커니즘과 달리 계정의 is_active 및 is_confirmed 상태를 확인하지 않았습니다.


자체 등록 프로세스에서는 계정 확인이 완료되기 전에 API 키를 발급하므로 공격자는 계정을 만들고 결과 API 키를 즉시 사용하여 확인된 활성 사용자에게만 제공되어야 하는 Pub/Sub 주제에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 이는 댓글과 같이 새로 제출되었거나 아직 조정되지 않은 데이터를 포함하여 REST API를 통해 액세스할 수 없는 스트림 이벤트를 노출할 수 있습니다.


이 취약점은 REST API와 SSE 스트리밍 인터페이스 간의 일관되지 않은 인증 적용으로 인해 발생합니다.


패치는 Pub/Sub 스트림에 대한 액세스를 허용하기 전에 계정이 활성화되고 확인되도록 요구하여 SSE 인증 경계를 REST API에 맞춰 문제를 해결합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-47227 - Admidio module-administrator can delete or reorder categories owned by other modules via dead authorization check in `modules/categories.php`
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-47227
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:58 p.m. | 52 minutes ago
  
Description :Admidio is an open-source user management solution. `modules/categories.php` checks that the supplied `type` parameter (`ANN`, `EVT`, `ROL`, `USF`, …) corresponds to a module the actor administers. The follow-up "is this specific category editable by me" check at lines 56-61 is dead code because it compares `$getType` (a category-type code) against mode names (`edit`/`save`/`delete`); the condition is permanently false, so `$category->isEditable()` is never invoked. Prior to version 5.0.10, the `delete`, `sequence`, and `save` switch cases load the category by the supplied UUID and act on it without re-checking that the category belongs to a module the actor administers. A user holding only one module-administrator right can therefore destroy or reorder empty categories belonging to *other* modules — for example, an announcements administrator can delete role categories, profile-field categories, or weblink categories that they have no right to touch. Version 5.0.10 fixes the issue.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-53996 - NetBSD hdaudio(4) Driver Privilege Bypass Use-After-Free via HDAUDIO_FGRP_SETCONFIG ioctl
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-53996
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:42 p.m. | 19 minutes ago
  
Description :NetBSD's hdaudio(4) driver in sys/dev/hdaudio/hdaudio.c contains a missing access control vulnerability that allows unprivileged local attackers to invoke the HDAUDIO_FGRP_SETCONFIG ioctl without elevated permissions by exploiting the absence of an access check on /dev/hdaudioN device nodes. Attackers can repeatedly issue HDAUDIO_FGRP_SETCONFIG from one thread while keeping DMA and IRQs live from a second thread to trigger a use-after-free race condition in hdafg_detach() between stream_stop() and stream_disestablish(), where a latched DMA interrupt dereferences a freed callback pointer, resulting in outcomes ranging from audio-subsystem denial of service and kernel panic to potential local kernel privilege escalation.
  
Severity: 7.3 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-11325 - cloudflare/pages-action is deprecated — migration required by September 18th, 2026
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-11325
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 11:31 a.m. | 19 minutes ago
  
Description :Description



Cloudflare was recently notified by external researchers of vulnerabilities in this archived repository, including a remote code execution issue in `src/index.ts` reachable from certain GitHub Actions workflow configurations. Successful exploitation may expose workflow secrets such as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN to an attacker. Because this repository has been deprecated since 2024, Cloudflare will not be issuing patches. To remediate this issue, we recommend migrating to `cloudflare/wrangler-action` immediately. Consumers who have already migrated are not affected.




Sunset Date



The cloudflare/pages-action repository will be removed on 2026-09-07. Consumers must complete migration before 7th September to avoid CI disruption.




Affected Versions



All published versions of cloudflare/pages-action, including consumers pinned to the v1 moving tag.




Patched Versions



None. This repository will not receive further updates, including security patches.




Resolution / Migration Path
Migrate all workflows using cloudflare/pages-action to `cloudflare/wrangler-action` before 2026-07-18. Refer to the wrangler-action README for the equivalent step configuration and migration guidance.

Cloudflare는 최근 특정 GitHub Actions 워크플로 구성에서 연결할 수 있는 'src/index.ts'의 원격 코드 실행 문제를 포함하여 이 보관된 저장소의 취약성에 대해 외부 연구원으로부터 통보를 받았습니다. 악용에 성공하면 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN 및 GITHUB_TOKEN과 같은 워크플로 비밀이 공격자에게 노출될 수 있습니다. 이 저장소는 2024년부터 더 이상 사용되지 않으므로 Cloudflare는 패치를 발행하지 않습니다. 이 문제를 해결하려면 즉시 'cloudflare/wrangler-action'으로 마이그레이션하는 것이 좋습니다. 이미 마이그레이션한 소비자는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

cloudflare/pages-action 저장소는 2026년 9월 7일에 제거됩니다. CI 중단을 방지하려면 소비자는 9월 7일 이전에 마이그레이션을 완료해야 합니다.




영향을 받는 버전



v1 이동 태그에 고정된 소비자를 포함하여 cloudflare/pages-action의 모든 게시된 버전.




패치된 버전



없음. 이 저장소는 보안 패치를 포함한 추가 업데이트를 받지 않습니다.




해결/이전 경로
2026년 7월 18일 이전에 cloudflare/pages-action을 사용하는 모든 워크플로를 'cloudflare/wrangler-action'으로 마이그레이션하세요. 동등한 단계 구성 및 마이그레이션 지침은 wrangler-action README를 참조하세요.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-19566 - Net::CIDR::Set versions before 0.23 for Perl allow memory exhaustion and malformed set ranges via unbounded IPv6 prefix lengths
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-19566
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 8:39 a.m. | 24 minutes ago
  
Description :Net::CIDR::Set versions before 0.23 for Perl allow memory exhaustion and malformed set ranges via unbounded IPv6 prefix lengths.

The _encode method accepts any prefix length matching `(0|[1-9][0-9]*)` and passes it to _width2bits(), which builds the mask as `'1' x ($width + 8)`, one character per bit. The _inc() method then unpacks the packed mask into a Perl array of one scalar per byte, so the prefix length alone sets the allocation size: `::/100000000` builds a 100 MB string and a 12.5 million element array. The value being tested is parsed, not just the configured ranges: contains() builds a set from its argument, and _guess_coder() tries the IPv4 coder and then the IPv6 coder, so an IPv4-only set expands an oversized IPv6 prefix length before the mixed address width check rejects it.

Any caller that passes untrusted input to contains() or add() can exhaust process memory. A prefix length above 128 is also stored as a range that does not match the requested block: 2001:db8::/129 stringifies back unchanged, contains() of its own base address returns false, and removing it from a set drops the base address while the set still prints as covering it.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-19594 - Path Traversal and HTTP Parameter Pollution in Snowflake Python API (snowflake.core) Allow Confused-Deputy Privilege Escalation
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-19594
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 5:22 a.m. | 31 minutes ago
  
Description :Insufficient input sanitization in Snowflake Python API (`snowflake.core`) versions prior to 1.13.0 allowed confused-deputy privilege escalation through two related weaknesses: path traversal (CWE-22) via unencoded `..` identifier path segments, and HTTP parameter pollution (CWE-141) via unencoded `&`/`#`/`=` characters in query string values. An attacker with access to a downstream application built on snowflake.core could exploit the path traversal by supplying `..` as an object name, causing `snowflake.core` to issue REST requests against a parent resource or exploit the parameter pollution by injecting `&`/`#`/`=` into a free-form name field to override constraints on swap, clone, or rename operations — all executed under the application's privileged session. Successful exploitation requires the attacker to control an identifier or object-name string in an application built on snowflake.core that passes it to `snowflake.core` under a higher-privileged Snowflake session (e.g., an EXECUTE AS OWNER stored procedure, Streamlit app, or Native App). The fix is available in Snowflake Python API version 1.13.0, which also addresses several additional security findings. Users must manually upgrade.
  
Severity: 8.1 | HIGH

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-12233 - Uninitialized mutex in TLS trusted-credential backend causes kernel NULL-deref DoS under contention
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-12233
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 3:54 a.m. | 1 hour, 9 minutes ago
  
Description :The PSA Protected Storage credential backend (subsys/net/lib/tls_credentials/tls_credentials_trusted.c) declared its credential-store mutex as a plain zero-filled static struct k_mutex credential_lock; and never called k_mutex_init() on it. A statically zero-filled k_mutex has an uninitialized wait queue (its dlist head/tail are NULL instead of the self-referential sentinels that k_mutex_init/K_MUTEX_DEFINE install). The uncontended lock path does not touch the wait queue, so the defect is latent and serialized use behaves correctly.

When two execution contexts contend on the lock, k_mutex_lock() pends the blocking thread on the wait queue via z_pend_curr(), which calls sys_dlist_append() on the zeroed list and dereferences a NULL tail pointer (tail->next = node), faulting the kernel. The lock is held during TLS handshake credential loading and by all credential add/get/delete operations, so a deployment performing concurrent TLS handshakes (for example a server handling multiple simultaneous connections from a remote peer) or a credential-management operation concurrent with a handshake can trigger the dereference.

The impact is a denial of service: a deterministic kernel panic / device reset on the first contention. There is no memory corruption beyond the NULL dereference and no confidentiality or integrity impact; mutual exclusion on the fast path remains correct. Exposure is limited to builds with CONFIG_TLS_CREDENTIALS_BACKEND_PROTECTED_STORAGE enabled (PSA Protected Storage / TF-M platforms); the default volatile RAM backend initializes its lock correctly and is unaffected.

The fix initializes the mutex statically with K_MUTEX_DEFINE(credential_lock), providing a valid wait queue so the contended path no longer touches a NULL list.
  
Severity: 5.9 | MEDIUM
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

설명:PSA 보호 저장소 자격 증명 백엔드(subsys/net/lib/tls_credentials/tls_credentials_trusted.c)는 자격 증명 저장소 뮤텍스를 0으로 채워진 일반 정적 구조체 k_mutex credential_lock으로 선언했습니다. k_mutex_init()를 호출한 적이 없습니다. 정적으로 0으로 채워진 k_mutex에는 초기화되지 않은 대기 큐가 있습니다(dlist 헤드/테일은 k_mutex_init/K_MUTEX_DEFINE이 설치하는 자체 참조 센티널 대신 NULL입니다). 경합되지 않은 잠금 경로는 대기 대기열에 닿지 않으므로 결함이 잠재되어 있으며 직렬화된 사용이 올바르게 작동합니다.

두 개의 실행 컨텍스트가 잠금에 대해 경쟁할 때 k_mutex_lock()은 z_pend_curr()를 통해 대기 대기열에 차단 스레드를 보류합니다. 이는 0으로 지정된 목록에서 sys_dlist_append()를 호출하고 NULL 꼬리 포인터(tail->next = 노드)를 역참조하여 커널에 오류를 발생시킵니다. 잠금은 TLS 핸드셰이크 자격 증명 로드 중에 모든 자격 증명 추가/가져오기/삭제 작업에 의해 유지되므로 동시 TLS 핸드셰이크를 수행하는 배포(예: 원격 피어의 여러 동시 연결을 처리하는 서버) 또는 핸드셰이크와 동시에 자격 증명 관리 작업이 역참조를 트리거할 수 있습니다.

그 영향은 서비스 거부입니다. 첫 번째 경합에서 결정론적 커널 패닉/장치 재설정이 발생합니다. NULL 역참조를 넘어서는 메모리 손상이 없으며 기밀성이나 무결성에 미치는 영향도 없습니다. 빠른 경로의 상호 배제는 여전히 정확합니다. 노출은 CONFIG_TLS_CREDENTIALS_BACKEND_PROTECTED_STORAGE가 활성화된 빌드로 제한됩니다(PSA 보호 스토리지/TF-M 플랫폼). 기본 휘발성 RAM 백엔드는 잠금을 올바르게 초기화하며 영향을 받지 않습니다.

수정 사항은 K_MUTEX_DEFINE(credential_lock)을 사용하여 뮤텍스를 정적으로 초기화하여 경합 경로가 더 이상 NULL 목록에 닿지 않도록 유효한 대기 대기열을 제공합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-18961 - Social Login, Passkeys, Magic Link & Email OTP – Passwordless Login by VentraConnect <= 1.4.3 - Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass via Spotify OAuth Callback
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-18961
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 2:25 a.m. | 1 hour, 2 minutes ago
  
Description :The Social Login, Passkeys, Magic Link & Email OTP – Passwordless Login by VentraConnect plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Unverified Provider Email in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.3. vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68441 - net/sched: Handle TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68441
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:17 a.m. | 46 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/sched: Handle TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains

When a TC filter attached to a qdisc filter chain returns
TC_ACT_REDIRECT (ex: via an eBPF program calling bpf_redirect() or an
act_bpf action), the redirect was silently lost i.e no qdisc classify
function handled TC_ACT_REDIRECT, so the packet fell through the
switch and was enqueued normally instead of being redirected.

This has been broken since bpf_redirect() was introduced for TC in
commit 27b29f63058d ("bpf: add bpf_redirect() helper"). We got lucky
for a long time because bpf_net_context was a per-CPU variable that
was always available.

commit 401cb7dae813 ("net: Reference bpf_redirect_info via task_struct
on PREEMPT_RT.") turned bpf_net_context into a task_struct member that
is only set up by explicit callers. Without a caller setting it up,
bpf_redirect() itself crashes with a NULL pointer dereference in
bpf_net_ctx_get_ri(). However, even with bpf_net_context available,
TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains cannot be honored without
adding skb_do_redirect() calls to every qdisc classify function, which
would require changes across net/sched/. Isolate it to ebpf core where
it belongs.

Instead, add a tcf_classify_qdisc() inline helper in pkt_cls.h, as a
wrapper around tcf_classify() for use by qdisc classify functions and
tcf_qevent_handle(). When the classify verdict is TC_ACT_REDIRECT,
the wrapper converts it to TC_ACT_SHOT, dropping the packet rather
than letting it continue silently. Dropping is preferred over
letting the packet through because the user immediately sees packet
loss. Silently passing the packet through would hide the problem and
leave the user wondering why their redirect is not working.

The clsact fast path, tc_run() continues to call tcf_classify() directly
and is unaffected: TC_ACT_REDIRECT is returned as-is and handled by
sch_handle_egress/ingress() calling skb_do_redirect() as before.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-68441 - net/sched: qdisc 필터 체인에서 TC_ACT_REDIRECT 처리
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68441
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 12일 오전 12시 17분 | 46분 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

net/sched: qdisc 필터 체인에서 TC_ACT_REDIRECT를 처리합니다.

qdisc 필터 체인에 연결된 TC 필터가 반환될 때
TC_ACT_REDIRECT(예: bpf_redirect()를 호출하는 eBPF 프로그램을 통해 또는
act_bpf 작업), 리디렉션이 자동으로 손실되었습니다. 즉, qdisc 분류가 없습니다.
함수가 TC_ACT_REDIRECT를 처리하므로 패킷이
전환되었으며 리디렉션되는 대신 정상적으로 대기열에 추가되었습니다.

이는 bpf_redirect()가 TC에 도입된 이후로 깨졌습니다.
27b29f63058d("bpf: bpf_redirect() 도우미 추가")를 커밋합니다. 우리는 운이 좋았어
bpf_net_context는 CPU별 변수였기 때문에 오랫동안
항상 이용 가능했습니다.

커밋 401cb7dae813("net: task_struct를 통해 bpf_redirect_info 참조
on PREEMPT_RT.") bpf_net_context를 task_struct 멤버로 변환했습니다.
명시적인 호출자에 의해서만 설정됩니다. 발신자가 설정하지 않고도
bpf_redirect() 자체는 NULL 포인터 역참조로 인해 충돌합니다.
bpf_net_ctx_get_ri(). 그러나 bpf_net_context를 사용할 수 있더라도
qdisc 필터 체인의 TC_ACT_REDIRECT는 다음 없이는 존중될 수 없습니다.
모든 qdisc 분류 함수에 skb_do_redirect() 호출을 추가합니다.
net/sched/ 전반에 걸쳐 변경이 필요합니다. ebpf 코어로 격리합니다.
그것은 속한다.

대신, pkt_cls.h에 tcf_classify_qdisc() 인라인 도우미를 추가하세요.
qdisc 분류 함수에서 사용하기 위한 tcf_classify() 주위의 래퍼
tcf_qevent_handle(). 분류 판정이 TC_ACT_REDIRECT인 경우,
래퍼는 이를 TC_ACT_SHOT으로 변환하여 패킷을 삭제합니다.
조용히 계속하도록 두는 것보다. 내리는 것이 더 바람직하다
사용자가 즉시 패킷을 확인하기 때문에 패킷을 통과시키게 됩니다.
손실. 패킷을 조용히 전달하면 문제가 숨겨지고
사용자가 리디렉션이 작동하지 않는 이유를 궁금해하게 만듭니다.

clsact 단축 경로인 tc_run()은 계속해서 tcf_classify()를 직접 호출합니다.
영향을 받지 않습니다. TC_ACT_REDIRECT는 있는 그대로 반환되고 다음에 의해 처리됩니다.
sch_handle_egress/ingress()는 이전과 같이 skb_do_redirect()를 호출합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68438 - smp: Make CSD lock acquisition atomic for debug mode
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68438
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:17 a.m. | 46 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smp: Make CSD lock acquisition atomic for debug mode

Commit b0473dcd4b1d ("smp: Improve smp_call_function_single()
CSD-lock diagnostics") changed smp_call_function_single() so that,
when CSD lock debugging is enabled, async !wait calls use the
destination CPU csd_data. That improves diagnostics, but it also removes
the single-writer property that made the old csd_lock() safe: multiple
CPUs can now prepare the same destination CPU CSD concurrently.

csd_lock() currently waits for CSD_FLAG_LOCK to clear and then sets the
bit with a non-atomic read-modify-write. Two senders can both see an
unlocked CSD, set the bit, overwrite the callback fields, and enqueue
the same llist node. Re-adding a node that is already the queue head can
make node->next point to itself, leaving the target CPU stuck walking
call_single_queue. Later synchronous work, such as a TLB shootdown, can
then remain queued and trigger soft-lockup warnings or panics.

Keep the single csd_lock() implementation, but when CSD lock debugging is
enabled, acquire CSD_FLAG_LOCK with try_cmpxchg_acquire(). This makes the
destination CPU CSD a real atomic lock in the only configuration where it
can be shared by multiple remote senders, while preserving the existing
non-debug fast path.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68437 - drm/imagination: Fit paired fragment job in the correct CCCB
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68437
  
Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:17 a.m. | 46 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/imagination: Fit paired fragment job in the correct CCCB

For geometry jobs with a paired fragment job, at the moment, the
DRM scheduler's prepare_job() callback:

- checks for internal (driver) dependencies for the geometry job;
- calls into pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep() to check for external
  dependencies for the fragment job (the two jobs are submitted together
  but the common scheduler code doesn't know about it, so this needs to

Published : Aug. 12, 2026, 12:17 a.m. | 46 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/imagination: Fit paired fragment job in the correct CCCB

For geometry jobs with a paired fragment job, at the moment, the
DRM scheduler's prepare_job() callback:

- checks for internal (driver) dependencies for the geometry job;
- calls into pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep() to check for external

  be done at this point in time);

  to check its internal dependencies as well, passing the fragment job's

always take the mismatched fragment job and geometry queue into account,
in particular when checking whether there is space for the fragment
command to be submitted, so the code ends up checking for space in the
geometry (i.e. wrong) CCCB.
The rest of the nested prepare_job() callback happens to work fine at
the moment as the other internal dependencies are not relevant for a
paired fragment job.

Move the initialisation of a paired fragment job's done fence and CCCB
fence to pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep(), inferring the correct
queue from the fragment job itself.

This fixes cases where prepare_job() wrongly assumed that there was
enough space for a paired fragment job in its own CCCB, unblocking
run_job(), which then returned early without writing the full sequence

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-68437 - drm/imagination: 올바른 CCCB에 쌍을 이루는 조각 작업 맞추기
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68437
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 12일 오전 12시 17분 | 46분 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

drm/imagination: 올바른 CCCB에 쌍을 이루는 조각 작업 맞추기

페어링된 조각 작업이 포함된 형상 작업의 경우 현재
DRM 스케줄러의 prepare_job() 콜백:

- 기하학 작업에 대한 내부(드라이버) 종속성을 확인합니다.
- 외부 확인을 위해 pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep()을 호출합니다.
  조각 작업에 대한 종속성(두 작업이 함께 제출됨)
  하지만 공통 스케줄러 코드는 이에 대해 알지 못하므로 이를 수행해야 합니다.
  이 시점에 완료되어야 함);
- prepare_job() 콜백을 다시 호출하지만 조각 작업의 경우
  내부 종속성도 확인하여 조각 작업을 전달합니다.
  drm_sched_job 및 지오메트리 작업의 drm_sched_entity / pvr_queue.

마지막 단계의 문제는 pvr_queue_prepare_job()이 그렇지 않다는 것입니다.
항상 일치하지 않는 조각 작업과 지오메트리 대기열을 고려하세요.
특히 조각을 위한 공간이 있는지 확인할 때
명령을 제출해야 하므로 코드는 결국
기하학(즉, 잘못된) CCCB.
중첩된 prepare_job() 콜백의 나머지 부분은 다음에서 잘 작동합니다.
다른 내부 종속성이 관련이 없는 순간
페어링된 조각 작업.

짝을 이루는 조각 작업의 완료된 펜스 및 CCCB의 초기화 이동
pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep()에 펜스를 연결하여 올바른 것을 추론합니다.
조각 작업 자체의 큐입니다.

이는 prepare_job()이 잘못 가정한 경우를 수정합니다.
자체 CCCB에 쌍을 이루는 조각 작업을 위한 충분한 공간, 차단 해제
run_job(), 전체 시퀀스를 작성하지 않고 일찍 반환됨
CCCB에 명령을 보냅니다.

Description :TypeBot is a chatbot builder tool. Versions prior to 3.17.0 expose a deprecated public upload endpoint at `GET /api/v1/typebots/{typebotId}/blocks/{blockId}/storage/upload-url` that accepts an attacker-controlled `filePath` and returns a presigned S3 `PUT` URL for that exact key. Version 3.17.0 fixes this issue.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-48813 - Flawfinder output manipulation via untrusted filenames and source text
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-48813
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 7:24 p.m. | 22 minutes ago
  
Description :Flawfinder is a a static analysis tool for finding vulnerabilities in C/C++ source code. Versions prior to 2.0.20 have an improper input neutralization issue leading to output manipulation, specifically, Terminal/ANSI Escape Sequence Injection and XML Injection. A malicious file whose name contains ANSI escape sequences can end up being included in flawfinder's standard terminal output, with many effects. Untrusted fields (such as filenames, categories, or code context text) were not properly sanitized when generating structured reports. An attacker could exploit this to corrupt CSV formats or inject arbitrary XML attributes into SonarQube outputs via output_sonar(). It impacts those who use flawfinder to evaluate intentionally malicious filenames or file contents. This issue has been fully patched in Version 2.0.20 (released 2026-05-16). There is no configuration-based workaround within older versions of flawfinder. vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-48809 - python-engineio has possible denial of service due to maximum payload size sometimes not being enforced
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-48809
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 7:17 p.m. | 29 minutes ago
  
Description :python-engineio is a Python implementation of the Engine.IO realtime client and server. Versions prior to 4.13.2 have two specific configurations of the python-engineio server in which the size of incoming messages is not checked before the messages are loaded into memory. An attacker can take advantage of these to cause unnecessary memory allocations in the python-engineio server. The two cases are POST requests, when using ASGI with the long polling transport and WebSocket messages, when using Aiohttp with the WebSocket transport. Version 4.13.2 addresses this issue. ASGI severs now only load the body of incoming requests into memory after the client is confirmed to be known and authenticated, and the payload size is below the maximum allowed size. Requests that do not comply with these requirements are discarded. Aiohttp servers configure the maximum payload size in the underlying WebSocket layer from Aiohttp, so that large messages are discarded by Aiohttp before they are delivered to python-engineio.
  
Severity: 7.5 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
vulnerability.summary:
CISA has added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation.  

CVE-2026-20349 Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Heap Inspection Vulnerability
CVE-2026-68820 Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
CVE-2026-72898 Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability

These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise.
Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirements for Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies. BOD 26-04 reinforces the importance of the KEV Catalog and requires federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities, specifically those identified by Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) listed in CISA’s KEV Catalog on publicly exposed assets that grant total control of the asset post-exploitation, while deferring action for lower-risk vulnerabilities. BOD 26-04 further establishes basic expectations for when agencies must check whether threat actors compromised the system before the patch was applied.
While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities. CISA will continue to add vulnerabilities to the catalog that meet the specified criteria.
Aware of an exploited vulnerability not currently listed in the KEV Catalog? Submit it for potential addition through CISA’s KEV Nomination Form. Potential KEV additions must have a CVE ID, evidence of exploitation, and clear mitigation guidance

vulnerability.title_ko: CISA, 알려진 악용 취약점 세 가지를 카탈로그에 추가
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CISA는 현재 악용되고 있는 증거를 바탕으로 알려진 악용 취약점(KEV) 카탈로그에 세 가지 새로운 취약점을 추가했습니다.  

CVE-2026-20349 Cisco Secure Firewall ASA(Adaptive Security Appliance) 및 FTD(Firewall Threat Defense) 힙 검사 취약점
CVE-2026-68820 WinSock Use-After-Free 취약점용 Microsoft Windows 보조 기능 드라이버
CVE-2026-72898 메타베이스 SQL 주입 취약점

이러한 유형의 취약점은 악의적인 사이버 공격자가 빈번하게 사용하는 공격 벡터이며 연방 기업에 심각한 위험을 초래합니다.
구속력 있는 운영 지침(BOD) 26-04: 위험을 기반으로 보안 업데이트 우선 순위 지정은 FCEB(연방 민간 행정부) 기관에 대한 취약성 관리 요구 사항을 설정합니다. BOD 26-04는 KEV 카탈로그의 중요성을 강조하고 연방 기관이 고위험 취약점, 특히 공개적으로 노출된 자산에 대해 CISA의 KEV 카탈로그에 나열된 CVE(공통 취약점 및 노출)로 식별된 취약점을 신속하게 해결하는 데 우선순위를 두는 동시에 저위험 취약점에 대한 조치를 연기하도록 요구합니다. BOD 26-04는 기관이 패치를 적용하기 전에 위협 행위자가 시스템을 손상시켰는지 여부를 확인해야 하는 시기에 대한 기본 기대치를 추가로 설정합니다.
BOD 26-04는 FCEB 기관에만 적용되지만 CISA는 모든 조직이 위험 기반 취약성 관리를 채택하고 KEV 카탈로그 취약성 해결에 우선순위를 두도록 권장합니다. CISA는 지정된 기준을 충족하는 카탈로그에 취약점을 계속 추가할 것입니다.
현재 KEV 카탈로그에 나열되지 않은 악용된 취약점을 알고 계십니까? 잠재적인 추가를 위해 CISA의 KEV 추천 양식을 통해 제출하세요. 잠재적인 KEV 추가에는 CVE ID, 악용 증거 및 명확한 완화 지침이 있어야 합니다.

Background

Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing
Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide
Company Headquarters Location: Ireland


Vulnerabilities

Expand All +

CVE-2026-21655

Under certain circumstances, successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker on an adjacent network to achieve arbitrary code execution on the C-CURE 9000, victor application server and victor, as well as connected clients (e.g., workstations of physical security personnel). Such attack could impact physical security controls.
View CVE Details

Affected Products
Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000 and Victor application server (Update A)

Vendor:Johnson Controls
Product Version:Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000: <=v3.10.1, Johnson Controls victor Application Server: <=v4.10, Johnson Controls victor: <=v7.0
Product Status:known_affected


Remediations
Vendor fixJohnson Controls recommends the following upgrades to address the vulnerable deserialization path: Upgrade to C-CURE 9000 v3.20 or later
Vendor fixJohnson Controls recommends the following upgrades to address the vulnerable deserialization path: Upgrade victor Application Server to v4.20 or later
Vendor fixJohnson Controls recommends the following upgrades to address the vulnerable deserialization path: Upgrade victor to v8.0 or later
MitigationJohnson Controls recommends the following defensive measures to help reduce the risk of exploitation. Johnson Controls recommends following both steps in the mitigation guidance. However, until an upgrade is completed, the defensive measures outlined will reduce the attack surface: Firewall / access control lists - Implement strict firewall rules to block all unnecessary inbound connections to port 8999 from untrusted network segments. Intrusion detection / prevention - Deploy IDS/IPS signatures tuned to detect known .NET deserialization exploit payloads (e.g., ysoserial.net patterns) targeting port 8999. Application whitelisting - Enforce application whitelisting on application server hosts to prevent unauthorized executables from being launched by the server process. Least privilege - Ensure the application server process runs with the minimum privileges necessary, reducing the impact of successful exploitation. Monitor and audit - Enable detailed logging on application server hosts and monitor for anomalous process creation by SoftwareHouse.CrossFire.Server.exe. Disable unnecessary services - If the ClientConnectionManager_NF.SynchronousServerNotification callback interface is not required, disable or restrict it to reduce attack surface.
MitigationFor more detailed mitigation instructions, please see Johnson Controls Product Security Advisories JCI-PSA-2026-07, JCI-PSA-2026-13, and JCI-PSA-2026-16 at the following location: https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/trust-center/cybersecurity/security-advisorieshttps://www.johnsoncontrols.com/trust-center/cybersecurity/security-advisories

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-73161 - cti-transmute Conversion Table Allows XSS via Unescaped Cell Content During Search Highlighting
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-73161
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 9:07 a.m. | 14 minutes ago
  
Description :Affected versions of cti-transmute improperly handle conversion-table values passed through the search highlighting feature. The highlight() function previously returned the underlying text directly when no search query was supplied, or performed a regex replacement that inserted  tags without first escaping the original content. Because the resulting value is used by an HTML-rendering sink, malicious markup contained in conversion data could be interpreted as HTML rather than displayed as text.

The fix introduces a shared highlightMatches() helper that first converts special characters such as <, >, &, and quotes into HTML entities. Only after escaping does the code insert the application-controlled  element used for search highlighting.
  
Severity: 5.1 | MEDIUM
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-72693 - Kbd: local privilege escalation in openvt via incorrect process owner verification allowing passwordless root login
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-72693
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 8:39 a.m. | 42 minutes ago
  
Description :`openvt -u` is intended to identify the owner of the current VT and then execute `login` as that user from a privileged context. In the documented `kbrequest`/init usage, the ownership test in `authenticate_user()` relies on `stat("/proc//fd/0")`. `stat()` on `/proc//fd/0` follows the symlink to the underlying TTY device node. As a result, `buf.st_uid` reflects the owner of the TTY node rather than the owner of the process holding the file descriptor. If the TTY owner returns to `root` or the getty owner after logout while an unprivileged process still has `fd 0` attached to that TTY, the check can incorrectly treat that process as belonging to the privileged console owner. Once that check succeeds, the `-u` path executes a passwordless login as the selected user. In the documented `kbrequest`/init deployment using `openvt -us`, this can result in passwordless `login -f root` on the spawned VT. This report establishes that privilege escalation path for that documented deployment; it does not claim equivalent reachability for deployments that do not use `openvt -u` from a privileged `kbrequest`/init path.
  
Severity: 7.8 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

설명:`openvt -u`는 현재 VT의 소유자를 식별한 다음 권한 있는 컨텍스트에서 해당 사용자로 `login`을 실행하기 위한 것입니다. 문서화된 `kbrequest`/init 사용법에서 `authenticate_user()`의 소유권 테스트는 `stat("/proc//fd/0")`에 의존합니다. `/proc//fd/0`의 `stat()`은 기본 TTY 장치 노드에 대한 심볼릭 링크를 따릅니다. 결과적으로 `buf.st_uid`는 파일 설명자를 보유하는 프로세스의 소유자가 아닌 TTY 노드의 소유자를 반영합니다. 권한이 없는 프로세스에 여전히 해당 TTY에 'fd 0'이 연결되어 있는 동안 TTY 소유자가 로그아웃 후 'root' 또는 getty 소유자로 돌아가는 경우 검사에서는 해당 프로세스를 권한 있는 콘솔 소유자에 속하는 것으로 잘못 처리할 수 있습니다. 해당 확인이 성공하면 '-u' 경로는 선택된 사용자로 비밀번호 없는 로그인을 실행합니다. `openvt -us`를 사용하는 문서화된 `kbrequest`/init 배포에서 생성된 VT에 비밀번호 없는 `login -f root`가 발생할 수 있습니다. 이 보고서는 문서화된 배포에 대한 권한 상승 경로를 설정합니다. 권한 있는 `kbrequest`/init 경로에서 `openvt -u`를 사용하지 않는 배포에 대해 동등한 연결 가능성을 주장하지 않습니다.
  
심각도: 7.8 | 높음

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-19418 - TYPO3 CMS - Broken Access Control in Backend and Install Tool
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-19418
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 8:17 a.m. | 1 hour, 4 minutes ago
  
Description :The referrer enforcement introduced with  TYPO3-CORE-SA-2020-006 https://news.typo3.com/security/advisory/typo3-core-sa-2020-006  ( CVE-2020-11069 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord ) became ineffective in TYPO3 v13.0, where TYPO3 CMS started serving the backend and Install Tool applications from the site's main entry script instead of the dedicated typo3/ directory. Whether a request originated from the backend or Install Tool itself was determined by comparing the referrer against the directory of the entry script, which since then is the site root. As a consequence, requests originating from any script running on one of the TYPO3 instance's own domains, such as a frontend page, were accepted by backend routes and Install Tool endpoints. Attackers able to execute JavaScript on one of those domains, for instance by exploiting a cross-site scripting vulnerability, could invoke these endpoints via Fetch/XHR with the privileges of an authenticated victim's user session. This issue affects TYPO3 CMS versions 13.0.0-13.4.33 and 14.0.0-14.3.5.
  
Severity: 7.3 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-12051 - NULL pointer dereference in USB DFU device_next download handler (handle_download)
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-12051
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 5:31 a.m. | 21 minutes ago
  
Description :The USB DFU class implementation in Zephyr's new (experimental) device_next USB device stack contains a NULL pointer dereference in handle_download() (subsys/usb/device_next/class/usbd_dfu.c). The handler computes MIN(setup->wLength, buf->len) and passes buf->data to the image write callback without checking that the buf net_buf pointer is non-NULL.

The handler is reached over the USB control endpoint, driven by the USB host. For a DFU_DNLOAD (download) request with no Data OUT stage — notably the zero-length terminating download that the DFU protocol uses to end a firmware transfer — the USB core invokes the class handler with a NULL buffer. After the device has been advanced to the DFU_DNLOAD_IDLE state (by sending one valid download block and a GET_STATUS), a zero-length DFU_DNLOAD reaches handle_download() with buf == NULL, dereferencing it.

The result is a NULL+offset read that triggers a fatal CPU fault, i.e. a denial of service (device crash/reset). The attacker is whatever controls the USB host the device is attached to; DFU download support must be enabled with a registered image. There is no memory corruption or information disclosure — impact is limited to availability. The fix adds an explicit if (buf != NULL) guard so the callback receives a zero-length, NULL-data transfer instead of crashing.
  
Severity: 4.6 | MEDIUM
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-12051 - USB DFU device_next 다운로드 핸들러(handle_download)의 NULL 포인터 역참조
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-12051
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 11일 오전 5시 31분 | 21분 전
  
설명: Zephyr의 새로운(실험적) device_next USB 장치 스택의 USB DFU 클래스 구현에는 handler_download()(subsys/usb/device_next/class/usbd_dfu.c)에 NULL 포인터 역참조가 포함되어 있습니다. 핸들러는 MIN(setup->wLength, buf->len)을 계산하고 buf net_buf 포인터가 NULL이 아닌지 확인하지 않고 buf->data를 이미지 쓰기 콜백에 전달합니다.

핸들러는 USB 호스트에 의해 구동되는 USB 제어 엔드포인트를 통해 도달됩니다. Data OUT 단계가 없는 DFU_DNLOAD(다운로드) 요청(특히 DFU 프로토콜이 펌웨어 전송을 종료하기 위해 사용하는 길이가 0인 종료 다운로드)의 경우 USB 코어는 NULL 버퍼를 사용하여 클래스 핸들러를 호출합니다. 장치가 DFU_DNLOAD_IDLE 상태로 발전한 후(유효한 다운로드 블록 하나와 GET_STATUS를 전송하여), 길이가 0인 DFU_DNLOAD는 buf == NULL을 사용하여 역참조하여 handler_download()에 도달합니다.

결과는 치명적인 CPU 오류, 즉 서비스 거부(장치 충돌/리셋)를 유발하는 NULL+오프셋 읽기입니다. 공격자는 장치가 연결된 USB 호스트를 제어하는 ​​모든 것입니다. DFU 다운로드 지원은 등록된 이미지로 활성화되어야 합니다. 메모리 손상이나 정보 공개가 없으며 영향은 가용성으로 제한됩니다. 수정 사항은 명시적인 if (buf != NULL) 가드를 추가하여 콜백이 충돌하는 대신 길이가 0인 NULL 데이터 전송을 수신하도록 합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-11985 - Cross-thread FPU register leak on ARM when FPU enabled without register sharing
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-11985
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 5:17 a.m. | 35 minutes ago
  
Description :On the Zephyr ARM port, enabling the hardware FPU (CONFIG_FPU) forces the "Floating point ABI" choice, which defaults to CONFIG_FP_HARDABI. Both FP_HARDABI and FP_SOFTABI permit the compiler to emit hardware FP instructions in any function, even code that never uses floating-point types. However, the callee-saved FP registers (s16-s31 / d8-d15) are only saved and restored across a context switch when CONFIG_FPU_SHARING is enabled (arch/arm/core/cortex_m/swap_helper.S and arch/arm/core/cortex_a_r/swap_helper.S), and prior to this fix selecting an ABI did not enable FPU register sharing, which defaults off.

In a build that enables the FPU with the default ABI but leaves CONFIG_FPU_SHARING disabled, the kernel preserves no callee-saved FP register state across thread switches. The documented precondition for this "unshared" mode — that only a single thread ever executes FP instructions — is silently violated because the compiler may generate FP instructions in every thread.

Under CONFIG_USERSPACE, where threads are mutually isolated, this becomes an information-disclosure boundary crossing: a victim thread can leave secret-derived values in s16-s31, and a co-resident unprivileged thread can read those registers directly (FP register access is not privilege-gated), recovering data left behind by another thread. Without userspace the same defect causes cross-thread FP state corruption (a correctness fault). The leak is bounded to the 16 callee-saved single-precision registers and is opportunistic, so impact is low.

The fix makes FP_HARDABI and FP_SOFTABI select CONFIG_FPU_SHARING and tags every thread with K_FP_REGS at creation, so callee-saved FP state is always preserved across context switches whenever the compiler may emit FP instructions.
  
Severity: 3.6 | LOW
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-11985 - 레지스터 공유 없이 FPU가 활성화된 경우 ARM에서 크로스 스레드 FPU 레지스터 누출
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-11985
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 11일 오전 5시 17분 | 35분 전
  
설명: Zephyr ARM 포트에서 하드웨어 FPU(CONFIG_FPU)를 활성화하면 "부동 소수점 ABI" 선택이 강제로 적용되며 기본값은 CONFIG_FP_HARDABI입니다. FP_HARDABI와 FP_SOFTABI는 모두 컴파일러가 부동 소수점 유형을 전혀 사용하지 않는 코드를 포함하여 모든 함수에서 하드웨어 FP 명령을 내보낼 수 있도록 허용합니다. 그러나 호출 수신자가 저장한 FP 레지스터(s16-s31 / d8-d15)는 CONFIG_FPU_SHARING이 활성화된 경우(arch/arm/core/cortex_m/swap_helper.S 및 Arch/arm/core/cortex_a_r/swap_helper.S) 컨텍스트 스위치를 통해서만 저장 및 복원되며, 이 수정 이전에는 ABI를 선택해도 FPU 레지스터 공유가 활성화되지 않았으며 기본값은 꺼졌습니다.

기본 ABI로 FPU를 활성화하지만 CONFIG_FPU_SHARING은 비활성화된 빌드에서 커널은 스레드 스위치 전반에 걸쳐 호출 수신자가 저장한 FP 레지스터 상태를 유지하지 않습니다. 이 "비공유" 모드에 대해 문서화된 전제 조건(단일 스레드만 FP 명령어를 실행함)은 컴파일러가 모든 스레드에서 FP 명령어를 생성할 수 있기 때문에 조용히 위반됩니다.

스레드가 상호 격리되는 CONFIG_USERSPACE에서 이는 정보 공개 경계 교차가 됩니다. 피해자 스레드는 s16-s31에 비밀 파생 값을 남길 수 있고, 공동 상주하는 권한 없는 스레드는 해당 레지스터를 직접 읽을 수 있으며(FP 레지스터 액세스는 권한 제한이 없음) 다른 스레드가 남긴 데이터를 복구할 수 있습니다. 사용자 공간이 없으면 동일한 결함으로 인해 크로스 스레드 FP 상태 손상(정확성 오류)이 발생합니다. 누출은 호출 수신자가 저장한 16개의 단정밀도 레지스터로 제한되며 기회주의적이므로 영향이 낮습니다.

이 수정 사항은 FP_HARDABI 및 FP_SOFTABI가 CONFIG_FPU_SHARING을 선택하고 생성 시 모든 스레드에 K_FP_REGS 태그를 지정하도록 하므로 컴파일러가 FP 명령을 내보낼 때마다 호출 수신자가 저장한 FP 상태가 항상 컨텍스트 전환 전반에 걸쳐 보존됩니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-11893 - Double free / use-after-free in Bouffalo Lab HCI driver send() error paths (hci_bflb)
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-11893
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 5:17 a.m. | 35 minutes ago
  
Description :The Bluetooth HCI driver for Bouffalo Lab on-chip BLE controllers (BL60x/BL70x/BL61x), bt_bflb_send() in drivers/bluetooth/hci/hci_bflb.c, violates the bt_hci_driver_api.send() buffer-ownership contract. That contract (documented at include/zephyr/drivers/bluetooth.h) requires the buffer reference to be consumed only on success; on error the caller still owns the reference and unrefs it. The driver instead routed all error paths through a shared label that unconditionally called net_buf_unref(buf) before returning the error code, consuming the buffer on failure as well.

When send() returns an error, the host TX path (send_buf() in subsys/bluetooth/host/conn.c) unrefs the same buffer again, believing it still owns it. This double-unref over-decrements the net_buf reference count. Because the buffer is a TX fragment whose destroy callback also decrements its still-queued parent buffer, the parent is freed prematurely while reachable on the connection TX queue, producing a use-after-free and corruption of the shared net_buf pool rather than a benign leak.

The error conditions are on the host-to-controller transmit path (controller send failure, or an unsupported H:4 packet type), so they are not driven directly by attacker-supplied radio bytes; a remote/adjacent peer can influence them only indirectly, e.g. by inducing controller TX failures under heavy link load. The consequence when reached is BLE-stack denial of service (crash / pool corruption) with possible further memory corruption, bounded to devices using one of these Bouffalo Lab on-chip controllers.
  
Severity: 5.9 | MEDIUM
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-11893 - Bouffalo Lab HCI 드라이버 send() 오류 경로(hci_bflb)에서 이중 해제/해제 후 사용
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-11893
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 11일 오전 5시 17분 | 35분 전
  
설명:Bouffalo Lab 온칩 BLE 컨트롤러(BL60x/BL70x/BL61x)용 Bluetooth HCI 드라이버인 drivers/bluetooth/hci/hci_bflb.c의 bt_bflb_send()는 bt_hci_driver_api.send() 버퍼 소유권 계약을 위반합니다. 해당 계약(include/zephyr/drivers/bluetooth.h에 문서화되어 있음)에는 성공 시에만 버퍼 참조가 사용되어야 합니다. 오류가 발생하더라도 호출자는 여전히 참조를 소유하고 참조를 취소합니다. 대신 드라이버는 오류 코드를 반환하기 전에 무조건 net_buf_unref(buf)를 호출하는 공유 레이블을 통해 모든 오류 경로를 라우팅하여 실패 시에도 버퍼를 소비합니다.

send()가 오류를 반환하면 호스트 TX 경로(subsys/bluetooth/host/conn.c의 send_buf())는 여전히 해당 버퍼를 소유하고 있다고 믿고 동일한 버퍼를 다시 참조 해제합니다. 이 이중 unref는 net_buf 참조 횟수를 과도하게 감소시킵니다. 버퍼는 소멸 콜백이 여전히 대기열에 있는 상위 버퍼도 감소시키는 TX 조각이기 때문에 연결 TX 대기열에서 연결할 수 있는 동안 상위 버퍼가 조기에 해제되어 양성 누출이 아닌 공유 net_buf 풀의 손상 및 해제 후 사용이 발생합니다.

오류 조건은 호스트-컨트롤러 전송 경로(컨트롤러 전송 실패 또는 지원되지 않는 H:4 패킷 유형)에 있으므로 공격자가 제공한 무선 바이트에 의해 직접 구동되지 않습니다. 원격/인접 피어는 간접적으로만 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 링크 부하가 심한 경우 컨트롤러 TX 오류를 유발합니다. 이에 도달하면 결과적으로 Bouffalo Lab 온칩 컨트롤러 중 하나를 사용하는 장치에 제한된 추가 메모리 손상과 함께 BLE 스택 서비스 거부(충돌/풀 손상)가 발생합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-66776 - Multiple vulnerabilities in SAP Business AI Platform (Approuter)
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-66776
  
Published : Aug. 11, 2026, 12:19 a.m. | 59 minutes ago
  
Description :SAP Approuter does not consistently enforce integrity verification on certain session-related request headers under specific conditions. An attacker with low privileges could send a specially crafted request that bypasses the integrity check and loads another user's session context. vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-11811 - Socket file-descriptor leak in UpdateHub OTA client start_coap_client() leading to resource-exhaustion DoS
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-11811
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 10:55 p.m. | 23 minutes ago
  
Description :The UpdateHub over-the-air update client's start_coap_client() in subsys/mgmt/updatehub/updatehub.c leaks the CoAP/DTLS socket descriptor on its connection-setup failure paths. The shared error: cleanup gated socket closing on a ret > 0 flag, but ret was set to -1 immediately after the socket was created, so when zsock_setsockopt() (DTLS) or zsock_connect() subsequently failed the gate was false and cleanup_connection() was never called. The open descriptor in the global ctx.sock was then overwritten by the next attempt, permanently leaking it from the socket / net_context pool until reboot.

The failing setup path is reached every time the OTA client tries to contact the UpdateHub server and the connection cannot be established — driven automatically by the periodic autohandler() poll (and on demand via the updatehub_probe()/updatehub_update() API or the updatehub run shell command). The DTLS handshake/connect outcome is influenceable by a network or on-path attacker who drops, resets, or otherwise disrupts traffic to the server, and also fails naturally whenever the server is unreachable.

Each failed attempt permanently leaks one descriptor; once the shared socket pool is exhausted, networking degrades device-wide until the device is rebooted, a denial-of-service condition. Severity is low because the leak rate is bounded by the configured OTA poll interval (default once per 24 hours), the effect is gradual and recovered by reboot, and only builds with the UpdateHub client enabled are affected. There is no memory-corruption, information-disclosure, or authentication impact.
  
Severity: 3.7 | LOW
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-11811
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 10시 55분 | 23분 전
  
설명: subsys/mgmt/updatehub/updatehub.c에 있는 UpdateHub 무선 업데이트 클라이언트의 start_coap_client()가 연결 설정 실패 경로에서 CoAP/DTLS 소켓 설명자를 유출합니다. 공유 오류: ret > 0 플래그에서 정리 게이트 소켓이 닫혔지만 소켓이 생성된 직후 ret가 -1로 설정되었으므로 zsock_setsockopt()(DTLS) 또는 zsock_connect()가 이후에 실패하면 게이트가 false이고 cleanup_connection()이 호출되지 않았습니다. 전역 ctx.sock의 열린 설명자는 다음 시도에서 덮어쓰여 재부팅할 때까지 소켓/net_context 풀에서 영구적으로 누출되었습니다.

실패한 설정 경로는 OTA 클라이언트가 UpdateHub 서버에 연결을 시도할 때마다 연결이 설정되지 않습니다. 이는 정기적인 autohandler() 폴링에 의해 자동으로 실행됩니다(요청 시 updatehub_probe()/updatehub_update() API 또는 updatehub 실행 셸 명령을 통해). DTLS 핸드셰이크/연결 결과는 서버에 대한 트래픽을 삭제, 재설정 또는 방해하는 네트워크 또는 경로상의 공격자에 의해 영향을 받을 수 있으며 서버에 연결할 수 없을 때마다 자연스럽게 실패하기도 합니다.

시도가 실패할 때마다 하나의 설명자가 영구적으로 유출됩니다. 공유 소켓 풀이 소진되면 장치가 재부팅될 때까지 장치 전체의 네트워킹 성능이 저하됩니다(서비스 거부 조건). 누출률은 구성된 OTA 폴링 간격(기본값은 24시간마다 한 번)으로 제한되고, 효과는 점진적이고 재부팅을 통해 복구되며, UpdateHub 클라이언트가 활성화된 빌드만 영향을 받기 때문에 심각도가 낮습니다. 메모리 손상, 정보 공개 또는 인증에 미치는 영향은 없습니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-8718 - Out-of-bounds write in DTLS peer Connection ID getsockopt (`TLS_DTLS_PEER_CID_VALUE`) in Zephyr net sockets/TLS
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-8718
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 10:40 p.m. | 38 minutes ago
  
Description :tls_opt_dtls_peer_connection_id_value_get() in subsys/net/lib/sockets/sockets_tls.c, which handles getsockopt(SOL_TLS, TLS_DTLS_PEER_CID_VALUE), passed the caller-supplied optval directly to mbedtls_ssl_get_peer_cid() without verifying the buffer was at least MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX (default 32) bytes. mbedtls_ssl_get_peer_cid() copies the peer-negotiated DTLS Connection ID (length 1..MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX) into that buffer without a destination-size parameter, so a caller-supplied optlen smaller than the CID causes a write of up to 31 bytes past the buffer end.

In CONFIG_USERSPACE builds the getsockopt syscall verifier (z_vrfy_zsock_getsockopt) bounce-buffers the user's optval into a kernel allocation of exactly optlen bytes (k_usermode_alloc_from_copy -> z_thread_malloc), so an unprivileged user thread that passes a small optlen on a connected DTLS socket with Connection ID enabled induces a kernel-heap buffer overflow, with the overflowing content being the remote peer's CID.

The defect requires CONFIG_MBEDTLS_SSL_DTLS_CONNECTION_ID, an established DTLS session with a negotiated peer CID, and (for the kernel-crossing case) CONFIG_USERSPACE. Introduced when the TLS_DTLS_CID option was added (v3.5.0).

The fix rejects callers whose optlen is below MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX with -EINVAL.
  
Severity: 8.4 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX(기본값 32)바이트입니다. mbedtls_ssl_get_peer_cid()는 대상 크기 매개변수 없이 피어 협상 DTLS 연결 ID(길이 1..MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX)를 해당 버퍼에 복사하므로 CID보다 작은 호출자 제공 optlen은 버퍼 끝을 지나 최대 31바이트의 쓰기를 발생시킵니다.

CONFIG_USERSPACE에서는 getsockopt 시스템 호출 검증기(z_vrfy_zsock_getsockopt)가 사용자의 optval을 정확히 optlen 바이트의 커널 할당으로 바운스 버퍼링하므로(k_usermode_alloc_from_copy -> z_thread_malloc) 연결 ID가 활성화된 연결된 DTLS 소켓에서 작은 optlen을 전달하는 권한 없는 사용자 스레드는 다음과 같이 커널 힙 버퍼 오버플로를 유발합니다. 오버플로된 콘텐츠는 원격 피어의 CID입니다.

결함에는 CONFIG_MBEDTLS_SSL_DTLS_CONNECTION_ID, 협상된 피어 CID가 있는 설정된 DTLS 세션 및 (커널 교차의 경우) CONFIG_USERSPACE가 필요합니다. TLS_DTLS_CID 옵션 추가(v3.5.0) 때 도입되었습니다.

수정 사항은 -EINVAL을 사용하여 optlen이 MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX보다 낮은 호출자를 거부합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-6426 - Qemu-kvm: vhost inflight migration vmstate integer type mismatch causes out-of-bounds access
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-6426
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 9:22 p.m. | 30 minutes ago
  
Description :A type mismatch vulnerability was found in QEMU's vhost inflight migration VMState handling. The destination buffer size is stored as a uint64_t but read by the VMS_VBUFFER load path as a signed int32_t. On little-endian hosts, a crafted incoming migration state with bit 31 set causes the value to be interpreted as negative and then implicitly converted to a very large size_t, leading qemu_get_buffer() to copy migration-stream data beyond the bounds of the mmap-backed inflight region.

This can result in a crash of the QEMU process or memory corruption. Exploitation requires control of the migration producer or write access to the migration channel, combined with a destination configured to use vhost inflight migration.
  
Severity: 4.4 | MEDIUM

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-48160 - react-tracked was vulnerable to malicious code execution via compromised commits
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-48160
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 9:17 p.m. | 35 minutes ago
  
Description :react-tracked provides state usage tracking with Proxies. Between 2026-05-18 19:26:36 and 2026-05-19 15:22:45, the default branch contained malicious commits 6978272a7d6ca02225cb747ea69f427512e33699 through 949f1a3d6bb1ff7d1a0dec892afd773e742627e8 that executed remote attacker-controlled code on developer machines during `npm install`. The commits were removed by force-push, but local clones, forks, and direct-SHA URLs may still contain them, and `npm install` against an affected checkout will still execute the code today. The package was not published to npm. `src/install.js` was added and wired into the `postinstall` script. It fetched a JavaScript payload from an attacker-controlled HTTPS endpoint (configurable via an environment variable), disabled TLS verification, and evaluated the response as code with `require` available. vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-72718 - goose: Arbitrary command execution in goose CLI via `goose review` via git core.fsmonitor
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-72718
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 4:19 p.m. | 28 minutes ago
  
Description :goose is general-purpose AI agent that runs on your machine. Prior to 1.44.0, the `goose review` command runs the system `git` executable to gather the diff for review without stripping attacker-controlled Git configuration. A malicious repository whose `.git/config` sets [`core] fsmonitor = ` causes Git to execute that command on the host during the index refresh performed by `git diff HEAD`. The command runs before goose contacts a model and without a submitted prompt, model call, tool approval, or trust prompt. The context-gathering Git process is not sandboxed and is outside goose's tool-permission model. Arbitrary commands run with the privileges and environment of the user running goose, allowing file access or modification and exfiltration of environment secrets and provider API keys. The vulnerable Git invocations are built by git_command() in crates/goose-cli/src/commands/review/handler.rs and are used by touched_files() and collect_diff() for `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git diff HEAD`. This issue is fixed in version 1.44.0.
  
Severity: 7.0 | HIGH
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-47754 - unauthenticated path traversal in Metacat 2.x
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-47754
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 4:19 p.m. | 28 minutes ago
  
Description :Metacat is data repository software that helps researchers preserve, share, and discover data. Versions 2.x through 2.19.1 and all 1.x versions contain an unauthenticated path traversal in the `archiveEntryName` parameter of the `action=read` endpoint that is part of the original 1.x Metacat API. `ArchiveHandler.readArchiveEntry()` concatenates the user-supplied parameter into a filesystem path without validation, and the surrounding `hasReadPermission()` check is commented out. An unauthenticated remote attacker can read any file accessible to the Tomcat process by sending a single GET request. Proof-of-concept exploits have been demonstrated and verified against this vulnerability, and it should be considered easily exploitable for any Metacat deployment < 3.0.0 by any user with access to the 1.x API. Through this vulnerability, production 2.x deployments are exposed to credential theft, client certificate and private key exfiltration enabling member node impersonation within the federation, embargoed research data disclosure, and broad system reconnaissance. Given Metacat's deployment footprint across the DataONE network of repositories and federally funded research programs, the population of exposed 2.x instances is non-trivial. The vulnerability was eliminated in Metacat version 3.0.0 and after by eliminating the entire Metacat 1.x API that exposed this vulnerability. The vulnerability was remediated in April 2024 with the release of Metacat 3.0.0, which removed the legacy Metacat API including ArchiveHandler.java. The commit message and issue reference architectural cleanup, not a security fix, and no advisory or CVE was issued. The 2.x branch was not and will not be backported, as is standard practice in Metacat, which only supports the most current release. 2.19.1 remains vulnerable with identical code and is beyond its supported lifetime. As a workaround, disable or restrict 1.x API servlets. Because the vulnerable 1.x API is no longer used or necessary in most Metacat deployments, restricting access to the old API endpoints can reduce or eliminate exposure for 2.19.x deployments.  After removing those features, restart Tomcat or whichever software is hosting the servlets.
  
Severity: 9.3 | CRITICAL
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-47754 - Metacat 2.x의 인증되지 않은 경로 탐색
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-47754
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 4시 19분 | 28분 전
  
설명:Metacat은 연구자가 데이터를 보존, 공유 및 발견하는 데 도움이 되는 데이터 저장소 소프트웨어입니다. 버전 2.x부터 2.19.1까지와 모든 1.x 버전에는 원래 1.x Metacat API의 일부인 `action=read` 엔드포인트의 `archiveEntryName` 매개변수에 인증되지 않은 경로 탐색이 포함되어 있습니다. `ArchiveHandler.readArchiveEntry()`는 유효성 검사 없이 사용자 제공 매개변수를 파일 시스템 경로에 연결하고 주변 `hasReadPermission()` 검사는 주석 처리됩니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자는 단일 GET 요청을 보내 Tomcat 프로세스에 액세스할 수 있는 모든 파일을 읽을 수 있습니다. 이 취약점에 대한 개념 증명 공격이 시연되고 검증되었으며 1.x API에 액세스하는 모든 사용자가 3.0.0 미만의 모든 Metacat 배포에서 쉽게 악용할 수 있는 것으로 간주되어야 합니다. 이 취약점을 통해 프로덕션 2.x 배포는 자격 증명 도용, 클라이언트 인증서 및 개인 키 유출에 노출되어 연합 내의 구성원 노드 가장, 금지된 연구 데이터 공개 및 광범위한 시스템 정찰을 가능하게 합니다. DataONE 리포지토리 네트워크와 연방 자금 지원 연구 프로그램 전반에 걸친 Metacat의 배포 공간을 고려하면 노출된 2.x 인스턴스의 수는 적지 않습니다. 이 취약점은 Metacat 버전 3.0.0 및 이후 버전에서 이 취약점을 노출한 전체 Metacat 1.x API를 제거하여 제거되었습니다. 이 취약점은 ArchiveHandler.java를 포함한 레거시 Metacat API를 제거한 Metacat 3.0.0의 출시로 2024년 4월에 해결되었습니다. 커밋 메시지 및 문제 참조 아키텍처 정리는 보안 수정이 아니며 권고 또는 CVE가 발행되지 않았습니다. 2.x 브랜치는 최신 릴리스만 지원하는 Metacat의 표준 관행처럼 백포트되지 않았으며 앞으로도 백포트되지 않을 것입니다. 2.19.1은 여전히 ​​동일한 코드에 취약하며 지원 수명이 지났습니다. 해결 방법으로 1.x API 서블릿을 비활성화하거나 제한하십시오. 취약한 1.x API는 대부분의 Metacat 배포에서 더 이상 사용되지 않거나 필요하지 않기 때문에 이전 API 엔드포인트에 대한 액세스를 제한하면 2.19.x 배포에 대한 노출을 줄이거나 제거할 수 있습니다.  해당 기능을 제거한 후 Tomcat 또는 서블릿을 호스팅하는 소프트웨어를 다시 시작하십시오.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-72759 - cti-transmute Conversion History Authorization Bypass Leads to Sensitive Data Disclosure After Conversion Deletion
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-72759
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 2:19 p.m. | 29 minutes ago
  
Description :In affected versions of MISP cti-transmute, the conversion-history details endpoint performs an incomplete authorization check. When a history record references a deleted conversion, the associated conversion lookup returns None. The previous logic only denied access when the conversion object existed and the visibility check failed. As a result, deleted conversions bypassed the authorization check and their retained history input/output could be disclosed to a user able to request the corresponding history entry. The July 22, 2026 commit changes the logic to deny access whenever the conversion is missing or the requester lacks permission

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68420 - xfrm: reject optional IPTFS templates in outbound policies
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68420
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 1:20 p.m. | 20 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfrm: reject optional IPTFS templates in outbound policies

syzbot reported a stack-out-of-bounds read in xfrm_state_find()
which flows from xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one().

Commit 3d776e31c841 ("xfrm: Reject optional tunnel/BEET mode
templates in outbound policies") disallowed optional tunnel and
BEET in outbound policies to prevent this. Later when IPTFS
added, it was not covered by that fix and can still trigger
the out-of-bounds read;

Extend the check to disallow optional IPTFS in outbound policies
as well. IPTFS should be identical to tunnel mode.
IN and FWD policies are not affected: xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one()
is only reachable via the outbound path.

Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 1:20 p.m. | 20 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfrm: reject optional IPTFS templates in outbound policies

syzbot reported a stack-out-of-bounds read in xfrm_state_find()
which flows from xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one().

Commit 3d776e31c841 ("xfrm: Reject optional tunnel/BEET mode
templates in outbound policies") disallowed optional tunnel and
BEET in outbound policies to prevent this. Later when IPTFS
added, it was not covered by that fix and can still trigger
the out-of-bounds read;

Extend the check to disallow optional IPTFS in outbound policies
as well. IPTFS should be identical to tunnel mode.
IN and FWD policies are not affected: xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one()
is only reachable via the outbound path.

vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68420
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 1시 20분 | 20분 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

xfrm: 아웃바운드 정책에서 선택적 IPTFS 템플릿 거부

syzbot이 xfrm_state_find()에서 스택 범위를 벗어난 읽기를 보고했습니다.
xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one()에서 흘러나옵니다.

커밋 3d776e31c841("xfrm: 선택적 터널/BEET 모드 거부
아웃바운드 정책의 템플릿')은 선택적 터널을 허용하지 않으며
이를 방지하려면 아웃바운드 정책에 BEET를 사용하세요. 나중에 IPTFS가 되면
추가되었지만 해당 수정 사항이 적용되지 않았으며 여전히 트리거될 수 있습니다.
범위를 벗어난 읽기;

아웃바운드 정책에서 선택적 IPTFS를 허용하지 않도록 검사를 확장합니다.
뿐만 아니라. IPTFS는 터널 모드와 동일해야 합니다.
IN 및 FWD 정책은 영향을 받지 않습니다. xfrm_tmpl_resolve_one()
아웃바운드 경로를 통해서만 도달할 수 있습니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68414 - wifi: cfg80211: cancel sched scan results work on unregister
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68414
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 1:20 p.m. | 20 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: cfg80211: cancel sched scan results work on unregister

cfg80211_sched_scan_results() can queue rdev->sched_scan_res_wk from a
driver result notification while a scheduled scan request is present. The
work callback recovers the containing cfg80211_registered_device and then
locks the wiphy and walks the scheduled-scan request list.

wiphy_unregister() already makes the wiphy unreachable and drains rdev work
items before cfg80211_dev_free() can release the object, but it does not
drain sched_scan_res_wk. A queued or running result work item can therefore
cross the unregister/free boundary and access freed rdev state.

The buggy scenario involves two paths, with each column showing the order
within that path:

scheduled-scan result path:        unregister/free path:
1. cfg80211_sched_scan_results()   1. interface teardown stops and
   queues rdev->sched_scan_res_wk.    removes the scheduled scan request.
2. cfg80211_wq starts the work     2. wiphy_unregister() drains other
   item and recovers rdev.            rdev work items.
3. The worker locks rdev->wiphy    3. cfg80211_dev_free() destroys and
   and walks rdev state.              frees rdev.

Cancel sched_scan_res_wk in wiphy_unregister() alongside the other rdev
work items. cancel_work_sync() removes a pending result notification and
waits for an already running callback, so cfg80211_dev_free() cannot free
rdev while this work item is still active.

Validation reproduced this kernel report:

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-68414 - wifi: cfg80211: 예약 취소 시 예약 스캔 결과 취소가 작동함
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68414
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 1시 20분 | 20분 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

wifi: cfg80211: 예약된 스캔 결과 취소는 등록 해제 시 작동합니다.

cfg80211_sched_scan_results()는 rdev->sched_scan_res_wk를 대기열에 추가할 수 있습니다.
예약된 스캔 요청이 있는 동안 드라이버 결과 알림. 는
작업 콜백은 포함된 cfg80211_registered_device를 복구한 다음
wiphy를 잠그고 예약 검사 요청 목록을 살펴봅니다.

wiphy_unregister()는 이미 wiphy에 접근할 수 없게 만들고 rdev 작업을 중단시킵니다.
cfg80211_dev_free() 이전의 항목은 객체를 해제할 수 있지만 그렇지 않습니다.
sched_scan_res_wk를 배출합니다. 따라서 대기 중이거나 실행 중인 결과 작업 항목은 다음과 같습니다.
등록 해제/해제 경계를 넘어 해제된 rdev 상태에 액세스합니다.

버그가 있는 시나리오에는 두 가지 경로가 포함되며 각 열에는 순서가 표시됩니다.
해당 경로 내에서:

예약 검사 결과 경로: 등록 해제/해제 경로:
1. cfg80211_sched_scan_results() 1. 인터페이스 분해가 중지되고
   rdev->sched_scan_res_wk를 대기열에 넣습니다.    예약된 검사 요청을 제거합니다.
2. cfg80211_wq가 작업을 시작합니다. 2. wiphy_unregister()가 다른 것을 배출합니다.

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68092 - time/jiffies: Register jiffies clocksource before usage
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68092
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 12:17 p.m. | 1 hour ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

time/jiffies: Register jiffies clocksource before usage

Teddy reported that a XEN HVM has a long boot delay, which was bisected to
the recent enhancements to the negative motion detection. It turned out
that the jiffies clocksource is used in early boot before it is registered,
which leaves the max_delta_raw field at zero. That causes the read out to
be clamped to the max delta of 0, which means time is not making progress.

Cure it by ensuring that it is initialized before its first usage in
timekeeping_init().

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68086 - mm/khugepaged: write all dirty file folios when collapsing
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68086
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 12:17 p.m. | 1 hour ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/khugepaged: write all dirty file folios when collapsing

[There is no upstream commit, as this code was removed by upstream
 commit 044925f9b565 ("mm: fs: remove filemap_nr_thps*() functions and their users")]

As-is, khugepaged and writable-file opening exclude each other. A file
cannot be open writeable and have THPs (because the filesystem is not aware
of them). khugepaged will never collapse file pages for files that are
opened writeable. On an open(O_RDWR/O_WRONLY), the page cache for that
particular file is dropped. This is fine because nothing could've been
dirtied.

However, there is an edge-case: collapse_file() might not be able to
coexist with concurrent writers, but it can coexist with dirty folios
(from previous writers). Therefore, the following can happen:

open(file, O_RDWR)
write(file)
close(file)
madvise(file_mapping, MADV_COLLAPSE, some non-dirty range)
open(file, O_RDWR)
 nr_thps > 0
  truncate_inode_pages()
    /* THPs are cleared out, but so are the dirty folios */

When this edge-case happens, there is data loss, as the dirty folios are
fully discarded.

Fix it by fully writing back the page cache (and waiting) when collapsing
file THPs. Doing so provides the guarantee that no dirty folio will be
observed while there are active THPs. To fully ensure this is safe, the
invalidate_lock needs to be held while doing the writeout, so that
do_dentry_open()'s page cache truncation excludes this write-and-wait.

As a side effect, move the nr_thps counter bumping outside the i_pages
lock. This is correct since the counter itself is an atomic_t and the
producer <-> consumer correctness is provided by a full memory barrier:
smp_mb() in collapse_file()/memory barrier implied by full ordering in
get_write_access() -> atomic_inc_unless_negative().
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-68086 - mm/khugepaged: 축소 시 더티 파일 Folio를 모두 작성합니다.
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68086
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 12시 17분 | 1시간 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

mm/khugepaged: 축소 시 더티 파일 Folio를 모두 작성합니다.

[이 코드는 업스트림에서 제거되었으므로 업스트림 커밋이 없습니다.
 커밋 044925f9b565 ("mm: fs: filemap_nr_thps*() 함수 및 해당 사용자 제거")]

현재로서는 khugepaged와 쓰기 가능한 파일 열기가 서로 제외됩니다. 파일
개방형 쓰기가 불가능하고 THP를 가질 수 없습니다(파일 시스템이 인식하지 못하기 때문에).
그중). khugepaged는 다음과 같은 파일의 파일 페이지를 축소하지 않습니다.
쓰기 가능하게 열었습니다. 열린(O_RDWR/O_WRONLY)에서 해당 페이지 캐시
특정 파일이 삭제되었습니다. 아무 일도 없었으니까 괜찮아
더러워진.

그러나 극단적인 경우가 있습니다:collapse_file()이 실패할 수도 있습니다.
동시 작가와 공존하지만 더티 Folio와 공존할 수도 있습니다.
(이전 작가들로부터). 따라서 다음과 같은 일이 발생할 수 있습니다.

열기(파일, O_RDWR)
쓰기(파일)
닫기(파일)
madvise(file_mapping, MADV_COLLAPSE, 일부 비더티 범위)
열기(파일, O_RDWR)
 nr_thps > 0
  truncate_inode_pages()
    /* THP는 삭제되지만 더티 Folio도 삭제됩니다 */

이러한 극단적인 상황이 발생하면 더티 Folio가 삭제되므로 데이터가 손실됩니다.
완전히 폐기되었습니다.

접을 때 페이지 캐시를 완전히 다시 쓰고 대기하여 문제를 해결하세요.
파일 THP. 이렇게 하면 더러워진 Folio가 발생하지 않는다는 보장이 제공됩니다.
활성 THP가 있는 동안 관찰됩니다. 이것이 안전하다는 것을 완전히 보장하기 위해,
writeout을 수행하는 동안에는validate_lock을 유지해야 합니다.
do_dentry_open()의 페이지 캐시 잘림은 이 쓰기 및 대기를 제외합니다.

부작용으로 nr_thps 카운터를 i_pages 외부로 이동합니다.
자물쇠. 카운터 자체가atom_t이고
생산자 <-> 소비자 정확성은 전체 메모리 장벽에 의해 제공됩니다.
Collapse_file()/메모리 장벽의 smp_mb()는 전체 순서에 의해 암시됩니다.
get_write_access() ->omic_inc_unless_negative().

vulnerability.title: CVE-2026-68428 - KVM: x86/mmu: Fix use-after-free on vendor module reload
vulnerability.summary:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-68428
  
Published : Aug. 10, 2026, 12:04 p.m. | 1 hour, 13 minutes ago
  
Description :In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86/mmu: Fix use-after-free on vendor module reload

mmu_destroy_caches() destroys pte_list_desc_cache and
mmu_page_header_cache, but leaves both pointers unchanged.  The pointers
live in kvm.ko, and therefore survive when a vendor module is unloaded
while kvm.ko remains loaded.

If creation of pte_list_desc_cache fails during a subsequent vendor
module load, its assignment sets pte_list_desc_cache to NULL and the
error path calls mmu_destroy_caches().  mmu_page_header_cache still
points to the cache destroyed during the preceding vendor module
unload.  Passing that stale pointer to kmem_cache_destroy() causes a
slab use-after-free.

Reproduce the issue on a v7.1.3 kernel with CONFIG_KASAN=y,
CONFIG_KASAN_GENERIC=y, CONFIG_KVM=m, and CONFIG_KVM_INTEL=m.  A
one-shot test hook forces pte_list_desc_cache to NULL on the second
invocation of kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init():

  1. Load kvm.ko and kvm-intel.ko, creating both caches.
  2. Unload only kvm_intel, leaving kvm.ko loaded.
  3. Reload kvm_intel and force initialization through the -ENOMEM path.

KASAN reports:

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x5b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  kmem_cache_destroy+0x21/0x1d0
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x5b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  Allocated by task 16817:
  __kmem_cache_create_args+0x12c/0x3b0
  __kmem_cache_create.constprop.0+0xb6/0xf0 [kvm]
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x13b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  Freed by task 16820:
  kmem_cache_destroy+0x117/0x1d0
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_exit+0x21/0x30 [kvm]

Clear both pointers immediately after destroying their caches so that
the stored state reflects the caches' lifetime and repeated cleanup is
safe.

With the fix applied, the same injected vendor module reload fails with
-ENOMEM as expected and produces no KASAN report.
  
Severity: 0.0 | NA
  
  Visit the link for more details, such as CVSS details, affected products, timeline, and more...

vulnerability.title_ko: CVE-2026-68428 - KVM: x86/mmu: 공급업체 모듈 다시 로드 시 use-after-free 수정
vulnerability.summary_ko:
CVE ID:CVE-2026-68428
  
게시일 : 2026년 8월 10일 오후 12시 4분 | 1시간, 13분 전
  
설명:Linux 커널에서 다음 취약점이 해결되었습니다.

KVM: x86/mmu: 공급업체 모듈 다시 로드 시 use-after-free 수정

mmu_destroy_caches()는 pte_list_desc_cache를 파괴하고
mmu_page_header_cache이지만 두 포인터는 모두 변경되지 않은 상태로 유지됩니다.  포인터
kvm.ko에 있으므로 공급업체 모듈이 언로드될 때 생존합니다.
kvm.ko는 로드된 상태로 유지됩니다.

후속 벤더 도중 pte_list_desc_cache 생성에 실패한 경우
모듈 로드 시 해당 할당은 pte_list_desc_cache를 NULL로 설정하고
오류 경로는 mmu_destroy_caches()를 호출합니다.  mmu_page_header_cache는 여전히
이전 공급업체 모듈 중에 파괴된 캐시를 가리킵니다.
언로드.  오래된 포인터를 kmem_cache_destroy()에 전달하면
슬래브 사용 후 무료.

CONFIG_KASAN=y를 사용하여 v7.1.3 커널에서 문제를 재현합니다.
CONFIG_KASAN_GENERIC=y, CONFIG_KVM=m 및 CONFIG_KVM_INTEL=m.  에이
원샷 테스트 후크는 두 번째 테스트에서 pte_list_desc_cache를 NULL로 강제 설정합니다.
kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init() 호출:

  1. kvm.ko 및 kvm-intel.ko를 로드하여 두 캐시를 모두 생성합니다.
  2. kvm.ko는 로드된 채로 두고 kvm_intel만 언로드합니다.
  3. kvm_intel을 다시 로드하고 -ENOMEM 경로를 통해 강제로 초기화합니다.

KASAN은 다음과 같이 보고합니다.

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x5b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  kmem_cache_destroy+0x21/0x1d0
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x5b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  작업 16817에 의해 할당됨:
  __kmem_cache_create_args+0x12c/0x3b0
  __kmem_cache_create.constprop.0+0xb6/0xf0 [kvm]
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_init+0x13b/0x170 [kvm]
  ...
  작업 16820에 의해 해제됨:
  kmem_cache_destroy+0x117/0x1d0
  kvm_mmu_vendor_module_exit+0x21/0x30 [kvm]

캐시를 삭제한 후 즉시 두 포인터를 모두 지우십시오.
